question: What additional wheel and petal configurations are addressed to the beautiful-faced goddess?
premises: An eight-spoked lotus-petaled form is named
inference: Further contemplative configurations of eight-spoked lotus petals and a sixteen-plus-one form are taught to the goddess.
uncertainties: The exact structure of ṣoḍaśaikaṃ is ambiguous
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, there is also the eight-spoked lotus-petaled form and the sixteen-plus-one form.
